maria: Quick note 6: release freeze starts Tue 08:00 UTC for 24h. Only emergency fixes allowed. Follow the exception flow below.

jordan: Emergency fixes only  does that include hotpatches to quant kernels?

maria: Quant kernel patches are risky. They need explicit sign-off from @release-lead + @sre and a rollback plan.

li: We're due to run an embedding canary that touches tokenization. Is that blocked?

maria: Tokenization-only fixes that are low-risk can proceed as a gated canary. No kernel/quant changes during freeze.

sanjay: Exception process quick steps?

maria: 1) PR + tests. 2) Exception form https://rdrw.in/release-exceptions. 3) Ping @release-lead + @sre. Ops will aim for a 1-2 hour approval.

release-lead: Add monitoring runbook link when requesting exception.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled Thu 2026-06-18 09:00-09:45 UTC for embed-v2. Reporter: @li.

maria: Changelog: runtime KV cache GC tuning; autoscaler cooldown; embed tokenization edge-case fix; console UX polish.

maria: TL;DR: Freeze Tue 08:00 UTC 24h, exceptions via form + ping, canaries gated.
